faq.question: How do I rank higher on local Google searches?
faq.answer: The biggest levers are a fully completed Google Business Profile, consistent NAP details across your site and directories, genuine reviews, and — for multi-area businesses — dedicated pages per town or suburb you serve. Our checker tells you which of these you're missing.

faq.question: Do I need a page for every town I serve?
faq.answer: If you genuinely serve multiple distinct areas, yes — dedicated location pages with unique content for each area are one of the strongest local SEO signals, and our checker specifically looks for this pattern.

faq.question: What is NAP consistency and why does it matter?
faq.answer: NAP stands for Name, Address, Phone — keeping these identical across your website, Google Business Profile and directory listings helps Google trust that all these mentions refer to the same real business, which strengthens local rankings.
